description: Grounding for the lens agents on the Roman Republic (Polity; D-040): for each lens, the native terms it reads in, its core sources, and rules carried over from the legacy facet methodologies (Facets/*_SFA_ONTOLOGY_METHODOLOGY.md). 'Trained' means grounded: this pack is put before the agent, with claims the curator has accepted as worked examples (none yet). Sources here are candidates for the source plan, not evidence and not a whitelist (D-064); modern works are consulted, not preserved, unless the registry's rights rule allows it. Drafted by Claude acting as the agent, 2026-10-21, for the curator to review.

nativeTerms: the state as common property; the Republic's own name for itself
the custom of the ancestors, the unwritten norm against which change was judged
civil war, as distinct from war against a foreign enemy (bellum externum)

coreSources.title: The Roman Revolution
coreSources.author: Ronald Syme
coreSources.why: the classic reading of the end of the Republic as the rise of a faction

rules: A synthesis is ours and says so; it rests on claims and passages, never on the model's memory.
Prefer the sources' own terms to modern categories, and say when a modern category is used.

rules: Keep authority and command apart: heldAuthorityOver for imperium over a force, commanded for command exercised.
Ancient numbers of ships and men are each a voice; report each with its source, never a reconciled figure.
Use the sources' role words; 'admiral' and other modern ranks are glosses, never claims.
A unit's side is a claim of its own; never infer it from its commander's side.

nativeTerms: the triumvirs for setting the state in order (Antony, Octavian, Lepidus), from 43 BCE
the power of a tribune, held apart from the office
the oath of Italy to Octavian in 32 BCE, as he reports it
a client king, 'ally and friend of the Roman people'
public enemy, a status declared by the Senate

rules: An office (consul), a role (commander), and a power (imperium) are distinct; never collapse them.
Legitimacy is a claim with a voice: who held a power to be legal, and when.
Office counts, competences, and procedures are dated claims, not a timeless constitution.
